source: first 60 s of the supplied Zumba video (155 s, 1920x1080, 30 fps, AAC 48 kHz). The audio/video are NOT in the repo.

method.tempo: MEASURED: onset-envelope grid fit on the audio (ffmpeg + numpy) -> 126 BPM, first beat 0.27 s
method.moves: JUDGED BY EYE from contact sheets (2 frames/s). No pose model was available offline, so there was no automatic skeleton extraction. Each move is the nearest of the game's trackable poses, not a frame-accurate transcription.
